gurmukhi.premise: ਰਵੀ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ, ‘ਪੇਪਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕੁਝ ਸਵਾਲ ਆ ਗਏ ਸੀ — ਸੱਚ ਦੱਸਾਂ ਤਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਹੀ ਆ ਗਏ ਸੀ।’

english.premise: Ravi said, ‘I could do some of the questions on the paper — actually, to tell you the truth, I could do all of them.’
english.hypothesis: Ravi could do all the questions on the paper.

items.label: entailment
items.explanation: ‘Kuch’ (some) would normally implicate ‘not all’, but the follow-up clause explicitly cancels that implicature. The item tests whether scalar implicatures are treated as defeasible; a model that applies the implicature mechanically will wrongly answer contradiction.

items.label: neutral
items.explanation: ‘Vekhange’ (we'll see) is a conventional hedge that leans negative without committing. The hypothesis is neither entailed nor contradicted — it counterbalances items where an indirect answer does license a firm inference, so that 'indirect answer' cannot be learned as a shortcut for 'contradiction'.
